description: This source file implements the CurrencyHttpClient class, which provides methods to initialize currency data, and asynchronously retrieve mock currency metadata and ratios as JSON strings. It contains embedded mock data for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: CurrencyHttpClient
classes.description: A class responsible for fetching currency metadata and ratios, currently returning mock data asynchronously.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CurrencyHttpClient with source currency code and response language.

methods.name: GetCurrencyMetadataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency metadata as a JSON string, currently returning mock data.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatiosAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves currency ratios as a JSON string, currently returning mock data.
